page.overview:
Who is Drath Mephruhn?

(spelled "Mephrun" in an earlier work) was a shade or dying mage who briefly achieved lichdom by placing a phylactery in Grog Strongjaw's chest. As an NPC, was played by Matthew Mercer.

Pike identified Drath as a "shade" Indeed, Drath's appearance and behavior resemble those of a "lich shade" from Pathfinder, which was used early in the pre-stream home game.

When he possessed Grog's body, the violet glow of his eyes was transferred to Grog.

Drath looked down on others to an extreme degree, describing the adventurers who interrupted his ritual as "worthless cattle". He called Grog's body "this behemoth's shell", and in his final fight he gloated and expressed contempt for his opponents constantly.
